evidence_against.relevance: Casey consistently initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks, indicating sustained interest.
Casey provided practical support for an important interview and attended a birthday dinner Drew identified as important.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods apart, showing continued initiative.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting the question, supporting a low-commitment interpretation.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled two advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Because Casey shows sustained interest but avoids definition and longer-term planning, Drew should directly clarify desired commitment and whether or when the relationship question can be revisited.

uncertainty_explanation: The record shows genuine consistency, initiative, and support, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience pattern, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support B.
